title: Reality of Prayer: Responding to the Creator's Acts with Knowledge, Love, and Gratitude

questions.question: How did the believers answer Allah’s mercy and kindness shown through His blessings?
questions.answer: They answered with thankfulness and praise.

questions.question: Why do the blessings in the world show that Allah deserves praise?
questions.answer: Because His gifts are spread everywhere and clearly show His generosity and care.

questions.question: What do the blessings themselves seem to do in this passage?
questions.answer: They seem to praise Allah by the way they exist and give benefit.

questions.question: How do the fruits of mercy point people to Allah?
questions.answer: Their beauty, order, and balance show His generosity and lead people to thank Him.

questions.question: What main idea is taught by the words about thanking Allah?
questions.answer: People should notice Allah’s favors and respond with praise and gratitude.

questions.question: Why is it hard for people to thank Allah as much as He deserves?
questions.answer: Because His blessings are so many and so great.

questions.question: Which is closer to the passage: blessings are random, or blessings are signs of mercy?
questions.answer: Blessings are signs of mercy.

questions.question: If someone enjoys Allah’s gifts but never thanks Him, what teaching from this passage are they missing?
questions.answer: They are missing that blessings should lead a person to praise and thank Allah.

questions.question: What is the first response described in the target passage?
questions.answer: A response of thanks and praise to Allah for His mercy and blessings.

questions.question: How is Allah described through the many gifts in the universe?
questions.answer: As the true giver who is merciful and generous.

questions.question: What does the passage teach about the things spread across the earth?
questions.answer: They are reminders of Allah’s favors and reasons to praise Him.

questions.question: Why are the gifts in the world compared to a market full of goods?
questions.answer: Because many kinds of blessings are openly placed before people.

questions.question: What do the orderly fruits show besides being food?
questions.answer: They show care, wisdom, and generosity from Allah.

questions.question: How does the passage connect mercy and thankfulness?
questions.answer: Allah shows mercy through blessings, and people should answer with thanks.

questions.question: What does this passage encourage believers to notice in daily life?
questions.answer: The many blessings around them in the world.

questions.question: Why does the passage mention all parts of the universe praising Allah?
questions.answer: To show that His blessings are so great that everything points back to Him.

questions.question: What is one good habit this passage teaches Muslim students?
questions.answer: To thank Allah often when they see or enjoy His blessings.

questions.question: In the target passage, what do believers do after seeing Allah’s mercy in His gifts?
questions.answer: They glorify Him and praise Him with thankfulness.

questions.question: What is shown by the many blessings found throughout the universe?
questions.answer: They show Allah’s mercy, kindness, and worthiness of praise.

questions.question: According to the passage, how do blessings “speak” without words?
questions.answer: Their existence, beauty, and usefulness point people to Allah’s greatness.

questions.question: What do the carefully made fruits testify to?
questions.answer: They testify to Allah’s generosity and mercy.

questions.question: Why are fruits mentioned as an example in the passage?
questions.answer: Because they are clear, visible signs of Allah’s giving and care.

questions.question: What kind of thinking does this passage ask from the reader?
questions.answer: It asks the reader to reflect on blessings and understand what they mean.

questions.question: What relationship between Allah and His creation is shown here?
questions.answer: Allah gives kindly, and creation points back to Him with praise.

questions.question: What is the central lesson of the target passage in one sentence?
questions.answer: Allah’s countless blessings should lead people to thank and praise Him.

questions.question: Who is being praised and thanked in the target passage?
questions.answer: Allah is being praised and thanked.

questions.question: What causes this praise and thanks in the passage?
questions.answer: Allah’s mercy and compassion shown through His many blessings.

questions.question: What does the passage say the blessings across the world are doing?
questions.answer: They are showing Allah’s praise and greatness.

questions.question: How do the blessings on earth help people understand Allah better?
questions.answer: They show His generosity clearly and help people see that He is the giver.

questions.question: What special quality of the fruits is pointed out in the passage?
questions.answer: They are arranged with order and made with beauty and balance.

questions.question: Why does order in creation matter in this passage?
questions.answer: Because it points to wisdom, care, and a generous Creator.

questions.question: What is a good summary of the believer’s response in the passage?
questions.answer: The believer sees Allah’s gifts and answers with humble gratitude.

questions.question: What mistake would go against the message of this passage?
questions.answer: Taking blessings for granted and not thanking Allah.

questions.question: How does this passage help build stronger faith?
questions.answer: It teaches people to connect what they see in the world to Allah’s mercy.

questions.question: What do the believers say with their attitude in this passage when they see Allah’s gifts?
questions.answer: They show that all praise and thanks belong to Allah.

questions.question: What is the reason given for praising Allah in the target passage?
questions.answer: He shows mercy and compassion through sweet and abundant blessings.

questions.question: How wide is the spread of Allah’s blessings according to the passage?
questions.answer: They are spread throughout the universe and across the earth.

questions.question: What do these widespread blessings teach about Allah?
questions.answer: They teach that His giving is generous and far-reaching.

questions.question: What do the beautiful fruits silently declare?
questions.answer: They declare Allah’s generosity and deserve to be a reason for thanking Him.

questions.question: Why is gratitude an important part of faith in this passage?
questions.answer: Because seeing Allah’s gifts should naturally lead a believer to thank Him.

questions.question: What can we infer about someone who notices blessings everywhere?
questions.answer: That person is more likely to remember Allah and be grateful.

questions.question: How does the passage move from looking at creation to worship?
questions.answer: It shows that seeing blessings should lead the heart to praise and thank Allah.

questions.question: What response to Allah is described in the marked passage?
questions.answer: A response of glorifying, praising, and thanking Him.

questions.question: What two qualities of Allah are especially highlighted there?
questions.answer: His mercy and His generosity.

questions.question: What do the gifts in the universe reveal about their Giver?
questions.answer: They reveal that He is kind, giving, and worthy of praise.

questions.question: Why does the passage point to blessings found all over the earth?
questions.answer: To show that Allah’s mercy is easy to see and surrounds people everywhere.

questions.question: How do well-made and balanced fruits support the message of the passage?
questions.answer: They are examples of blessings that show care, wisdom, and generosity.

questions.question: What is the cause-and-effect lesson in this passage?
questions.answer: When people recognize Allah’s blessings, they should respond with gratitude and praise.

questions.question: What does the passage suggest about the universe as a whole?
questions.answer: It is full of signs that point people to Allah and His favors.

questions.question: What wrong attitude is the opposite of the one taught here?
questions.answer: Being ungrateful and ignoring the giver of blessings.

questions.question: What is the best short summary of the target passage?
questions.answer: Allah’s blessings everywhere call people to praise and thank Him.
